stage0500_01:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Hehe... It's kind of embarrassing
　to have you make such a fuss over me.」

stage0500_01:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「What are you saying, Mr. President?
　Your hard work is practically
　what keeps $c going!」

stage0500_01:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Becoming an ace has made you even
　more powerful, Mr. President!
　Our future is secure now!」

stage0500_01:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Whatever, but what's with this
　'President' stuff?」

stage0500_01:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah, my apologies. I hear that out on
　the town at night, every office worker
　gets promoted to 'Mr. President.'」

stage0500_01:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「I don't get it. I'll ask $$木下$$.
　Thanks, $$ＡＧ$$!」

stage0500_01:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$柿小路$$
「Th-thank you, $$ＡＧ$$!
　After decades of office work, at last...
　I, $$柿小路梅麻呂$$, have made it!」

stage0500_01:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「To celebrate your achievement,
　Ikue is eager to mass-produce snacks
　every time you sortie, $$柿小路$$.」

stage0500_01:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$柿小路$$
「Oh...! The president and all
　the other children will be delighted.」

stage0500_01:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$柿小路$$
「Though $$木下$$, for one,
　would probably prefer a cash bonus...」

stage0500_01:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Rest assured, $$柿小路$$.
　Ace pilots also get a bonus
　to the funds they earn.」

stage0500_01:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$柿小路$$
「That is wonderful news. For our
　company's coffers and peace on Earth,
　I shall continue to give my all!」

stage0500_01:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Becoming an ace pilot has given
　your psychic powers quite a boost,
　$$タケル$$.」

stage0500_01:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$タケル$$
「...Why does that sound...
　so strange...?」

stage0500_01:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I shall train to become Super $$ＡＧ$$,
　so as not to lose out to your
　super-AQ powers, $$タケル$$.」

stage0500_01:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
（What a shame... I was hoping
　for a scathing retort delivered
　with an energy shockwave...）

stage0500_01:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
（Well... I suppose that kindness
　is part of $$タケル$$'s charm.）

stage0500_01:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$ケンジ$$
「Sorry. As commander of the Crusher
　Team, I have to eliminate anything
　that could put my crew in danger.」

stage0500_01:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That's our $$ケンジ$$!
　Your sense of responsibility has made
　the Crusher Team what it is today!」

stage0500_01:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'd love to join the Crusher Team
　and have you train me, $$ケンジ$$.」

stage0500_01:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$ケンジ$$
「...Sorry, $$ＡＧ$$. Even I'm not
　confident I could train you...」

stage0500_01:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Thanks, $$ＡＧ$$.
　But I didn't do this on my own.」

stage0500_01:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Of course, I know.
　Congratulations to $$鉄人$$ as well.」

stage0500_01:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Thanks. $$鉄人$$ and I
　will keep doing our best together.」

stage0500_01:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah... Such innocent eyes...
　I might even let you pilot me,
　$$正太郎$$...」

stage0500_01:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Really? Then come help me
　polish $$鉄人$$.」

stage0500_01:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes, gladly! I'll give our new ace
　$$鉄人$$ the full service treatment!」

stage0500_01:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Happy Ace Pilot!
　Congratulations, $$ブラックオックス#pilot$$!」

stage0500_01:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh... Not much of a reaction.
　Then let me put some more into it...」

stage0500_01:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「HAPPYYY ACE PILOOOT!
　Congratulations, $$ブラックオックス#pilot$$!!」

stage0500_01:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh... You seem pleased...
　Well then, from one robot to another,
　let me go at full power!」

stage0500_01:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Huh... I overdid it?
　...Sigh... Children are so hard
　to please... Honestly...」

stage0500_01:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ignoring me from the start...?
　Just the response I expected.」

stage0500_01:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I've prepared wine to celebrate.
　How about a glass?」

stage0500_01:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Just as I expected, again...
　Then let me prepare my finest coffee.」

stage0500_01:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Leave it to me! I'll put all my
　skill into brewing a bitter cup,
　Uoodo-style, from planet Melkia!」

stage0500_01:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$シャッコ$$
「I've wondered for a while.
　What's inside you...?」

stage0500_01:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「How rude!
　There's no person inside me!」

stage0500_01:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Honestly... I know people from
　$$クエント$$ tend to dislike technology,
　but that was rather insensitive.」

stage0500_01:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「No, no, I spoke too harshly as well.
　To make amends, I'll polish
　that prized pile bunker of yours.」

stage0500_01:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「There may even be a world where
　it's the key to saving humanity
　from a crisis...」

stage0500_01:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「So you say, but you don't
　look very pleased.」

stage0500_01:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$桂$$
「Well, if you were a beautiful woman,
　sure. But a squat little robot...?」

stage0500_01:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I quite understand. Just for you,
　$$桂$$, here's $$ＤＥＭ$$ Corporation's
　Super Dimension Beauties Catalog!」

stage0500_01:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I suggest the women of Spoponia,
　Parallel World 352. With eyes all over
　their bodies, their gaze is stunning!」

stage0500_01:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Or Opeporon's girls, with nostrils
　over 10 cm wide! And Mochitan's girls
　have rafflesia-scented pheromones.」

stage0500_01:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$桂$$
「Sorry, $$ＡＧ$$... I was an idiot
　to get my hopes up...」

stage0500_01:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh, come now. The $$エゥーゴ$$'s young ace
　is now an ace of $c.」

stage0500_01:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「And you've grown remarkably
　as a person too, $$カミーユ$$.」

stage0500_01:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes. It's hard to believe you were
　a short-tempered boy who fired a
　Vulcan pod at an unprotected man...」

stage0500_01:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「H-haha... I'll leave before
　you decide I need correcting.」

stage0500_01:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$ファ$$
「I... I've kept going because I
　wanted to fight beside $$カミーユ$$.
　I feel like I've finally made it.」

stage0500_01:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「By the way, may I ask a favor?
　'$$ファ$$-sama' is rather awkward
　to pronounce...」

stage0500_01:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Would you mind if I called you
　'$$ファ$$a-sama' instead?」

stage0500_01:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'll throw in a pork cutlet,
　and I'm sure that name would
　make you ever so popular...」

stage0500_01:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Thank you. I thought you might
　get angry at me for making
　a joke out of your name...」

stage0500_01:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$フォウ$$
「It's my name.
　I've accepted it now.」

stage0500_01:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「How lovely, $$フォウ$$.
　I hope I can take pride
　in my own name too...」

stage0500_01:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Thank you!
　I'm starting to like it myself!」

stage0500_01:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$エマ$$
「Thank you, $$ＡＧ$$. It's nice
　having someone celebrate with you.」

stage0500_01:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
$$エマ$$
「Even you know about him, then.」

stage0500_01:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Of course. If you wish, I can
　find out what he's been up to,
　or even investigate his private life.」

stage0500_01:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$エマ$$
「There's no need for that.
　I trust him.」

stage0500_01:r_53128ce8f154fd06.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ooh... Is that the confidence
　of a woman who knows she's loved?」

stage0500_01:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$$エマ$$
「You seem rather biased against him.」

stage0500_01:r_e598c2a0b27e7f50.text:
$$カツ$$
「Now I'm a full-fledged pilot.
　No more treating me like a kid.」

stage0500_01:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You say that, but $$ブライト$$
　and $$アムロ$$ knew you when
　you were a child, $$カツ$$.」

stage0500_01:r_10340119af3ed6db.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I doubt they'll ever shake that
　image of $$カツ$$ the crybaby.」

stage0500_01:r_23a9c7ab620ab112.text:
$$カツ$$
「Wait a minute, $$ＡＧ$$!
　How do you know about my past!?」

stage0500_01:r_4f0aca6deda07883.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Why, I wonder?
　In any case, do watch where
　you're going.」

stage0500_01:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
$$ブライト$$
「An ace pilot? That's an odd thing
　to call a ship's captain.」

stage0500_01:r_451f726d4299ea35.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then I have a question for
　the legendary Gundam captain.」

stage0500_01:r_e3d111e8bb190cb1.text:
$$ブライト$$
「Don't ask me to judge whether
　you have Newtype potential.」

stage0500_01:r_2ddff5064af78db4.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Look... I have something like
　an antenna, and two eyes too...」

stage0500_01:r_d583fcea31bdad2e.text:
$$ブライト$$
「For starters, painting yourself
　red, white and blue should
　help you look the part.」

stage0500_01:r_475f7653621a91b5.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Thank you!
　I'll try it right away!」

stage0500_01:r_f228ae702350849b.text:
$$ブライト$$
「Good.
　But I take no responsibility for it.」

stage0500_01:r_79c90de32a79212d.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Though you're well past needing
　that greeting, $$アムロ$$.」

stage0500_01:r_33f7fd55913419e8.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Not really. Having someone
　celebrate with me makes it feel
　a little more real that I'm still alive.」

stage0500_01:r_473d9a88b4ca96e7.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Please ask $$チェーン$$ to help
　you enjoy life's pleasures like that.」

stage0500_01:r_4de6ac85c63bac12.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Or would you prefer $$ベルトーチカ$$?」

stage0500_01:r_ce90563a934d49fb.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Even the legendary White Meteor
　can't take on several opponents
　at once in that arena.」

stage0500_01:r_4fb296e63cb1fb46.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Leave boasting about numbers like
　twelve kills in three minutes
　to your younger self, won't you?」

stage0500_01:r_6d77e72dbbcd7dfe.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Thank you, $$ＡＧ$$.
　I'll remember your advice.」

stage0500_01:r_fae689f2a1057b61.text:
$$シャア$$
「I never expected anyone
　to celebrate my achievement.」

stage0500_01:r_91c6d0bb53854ecc.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「How ironic. Removing your mask
　and sunglasses to show your true face
　drove a wedge between you and old friends.」

stage0500_01:r_42a3149105314ab8.text:
$$シャア$$
「I was prepared for all of that.
　...Though I find myself living
　in disgrace all the same.」

stage0500_01:r_62ecd978c667bd29.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「And yet you seem to feel
　a weight has been lifted.」

stage0500_01:r_d441e6cc908ac01b.text:
$$シャア$$
「Keeping needless secrets is stressful.
　I'm sure you understand.」

stage0500_01:r_2c7af4c55d8ac938.text:
$$シャア$$
「Heh...
　As long as you understand.」

stage0500_01:r_ef16bcaa2b0e0c45.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I've watched all your hard work
　up close, $$ハサウェイ$$.
　I'm as happy as if it were my own success.」

stage0500_01:r_2b93cca10f1c36a8.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But you still have a long way
　to go, $$ハサウェイ$$.」

stage0500_01:r_ac21212c36d2b9ad.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You can still grow. Don't decide
　what your own limits are and
　resort to extremist actions.」

stage0500_01:r_a26e2108358af7a4.text:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「I'll remember that, $$ＡＧ$$.
　...Though I don't really understand.」

stage0500_01:r_a8118b2e37aa1382.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That's fine for now. First, let's
　do our best at what's before us.」

stage0500_01:r_22c8caf8c08c5119.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'm delighted to be able to
　welcome you here, $$クェス$$.」

stage0500_01:r_9c13714b3efbc7a8.text:
$$クェス$$
「You're making too much of it, $$ＡＧ$$.」

stage0500_01:r_96f156e19b53fc09.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Not at all. You... Or rather,
　the you of another world played a
　crucial role in a certain family's future.」

stage0500_01:r_feb0390bba7fe1fb.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「One wrong step, and it might
　have affected this world too,
　bringing about a terrible tragedy...」

stage0500_01:r_8a78bcec22029401.text:
$$クェス$$
「Enough of that confusing stuff.
　Just congratulate me properly
　on becoming an ace, okay?」

stage0500_01:r_f42017dfce31dea9.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes, of course. Let's invite
　$$ハサウェイ$$ and $$ブライト$$
　to join in the celebration.」

stage0500_01:r_fd6bdf7910d7d925.text:
$$クェス$$
「So this is how $c
　celebrates things, huh?」

stage0500_01:r_d38be46e6cd7a5e5.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「What do you say? Why not leave
　Neo Zeon and join us officially?」

stage0500_01:r_3fe2078328753c16.text:
$$クェス$$
「If you can understand me
　the way the Colonel does.」

stage0500_01:r_c66844158d1ce600.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That's a tall order...!
　Even I'm not confident when
　compared to the Red Comet.」

stage0500_01:r_d037ecbc1e348dc9.text:
$$クェス$$
「...But thanks.
　It's nice having someone
　care about you like this.」

stage0500_01:r_bcd53d14c4785426.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Don't worry, $$クェス$$.
　I'm not the only one here
　waiting for you to join us.」

stage0500_01:r_aa5d235c78ebe19f.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Looks like you've finally
　recognized my ability.」

stage0500_01:r_0b3b19cddb871f90.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now, $$ギュネイ$$. I understand
　you want to prove yourself, but that
　attitude puts up walls between people.」

stage0500_01:r_304e98dac43c9333.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「If you call yourself a Newtype,
　you should open your heart more
　and connect with other people.」

stage0500_01:r_b740d817a14afd3a.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「...I'm only in this unit temporarily.
　There's no need for that.」

stage0500_01:r_40e4c010d1b35b4c.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I wonder if you'll still
　feel that way in the future...」

stage0500_01:r_3036adce91d1f4a8.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...Let's leave that for now.
　A toast to this fleeting encounter.」

stage0500_01:r_a5774604a0f00702.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well... It's better than having
　my invitation torn up.」

stage0500_01:r_9133b7e0b34de48f.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「If you're going to regret it later,
　you shouldn't do it in the first place.」

stage0500_01:r_a84ab0c3c1ba44d4.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
（What a relief...
　He didn't say, 'I'll kill you.'）

stage0500_01:r_414e6e90094d1413.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
（Though I hear that line of his
　actually means you're guaranteed
　to survive.）

stage0500_01:r_ddd97a6ef823929a.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Thanks, $$ＡＧ$$. Even coming
　from you, congratulations
　don't feel half bad.」

stage0500_01:r_df349052cd9cdd0c.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Not what I'd expect from
　a self-proclaimed God of Death.」

stage0500_01:r_a7ce9f908380694c.text:
$$デュオ$$
「True. I've rounded off my rough edges
　so much lately, I'd forgotten
　that's supposed to be my thing.」

stage0500_01:r_de3cc1f733dcb073.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Take a look at this impressive body!
　When it comes to being well-rounded,
　I won't be outdone!」

stage0500_01:r_0835ec3fff318aff.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Haha... With someone like you around,
　I lose the urge to play the God of Death.」

stage0500_01:r_660c72e627d873c7.text:
$$トロワ$$
「Sorry to put you
　to all this trouble.」

stage0500_01:r_5d8b67b5bd8ce190.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I've often thought this, $$トロワ$$.
　You're quiet, but you always
　give a proper reply.」

stage0500_01:r_7cf3c91395139f5c.text:
$$トロワ$$
「Catherine scolds me if I don't.」

stage0500_01:r_6ccd85652ef4ccf1.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The woman who's like a sister to you?
　I hope you can return to
　the circus soon.」

stage0500_01:r_fbe7bf7d854012a7.text:
$$トロワ$$
「...$$ＡＧ$$...
　Why don't you come to the circus too?」

stage0500_01:r_2e59226caa35f6e5.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...Very well. I'll start
　a new life as a clown
　alongside you, $$トロワ$$.」

stage0500_01:r_5d7a3adb077ad934.text:
$$トロワ$$
「No... I want you to jump through
　flaming hoops and work the trapeze.」

stage0500_01:r_8d461de418389bf8.text:
$$トロワ$$
「Besides, you already play
　the clown, don't you?」

stage0500_01:r_5cb2acefa1e7c7fb.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「And a surprise insult to top it off!」

stage0500_01:r_df899b8031b4ca06.text:
$$カトル$$
「Thank you, $$ＡＧ$$.
　I've only made it this far
　thanks to everyone around me.」

stage0500_01:r_c5d048c7db7cac75.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Just like you, $$カトル$$.
　Such modest words.」

stage0500_01:r_308e8ac66b1141ef.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You really are different from
　the other four Gundam pilots.」

stage0500_01:r_64f25294d71a5d55.text:
$$カトル$$
「Would you mind not
　bad-mouthing my friends?」

stage0500_01:r_432a29155221625f.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
（Close call... I almost forgot
　that when $$カトル$$ snaps, he's
　the worst of all the Gundam pilots.）

stage0500_01:r_9f7c18d1ea1b55c9.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
（Though I suppose that volatility
　is part of his charm too.）

stage0500_01:r_c7ef92060bb8199d.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh... Please, not that cold stare!
　We're both members of $c!」

stage0500_01:r_1be6d12f616f04e4.text:
$$五飛$$
「...True. And in this unit,
　you outrank me in seniority.」

stage0500_01:r_80f948aeaed93de8.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Let's just call ourselves equals.
　As comrades.」

stage0500_01:r_da648116badd491a.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Exactly. Keep giving your all
　for your dear comrades, $$五飛$$.」

stage0500_01:r_4e91ccecf1dd0f66.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
（Please spare us any more trouble
　with bottling things up and
　going over to the enemy.）

stage0500_01:r_075101b23517fbaa.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「I'm not someone who deserves
　anyone's congratulations.」

stage0500_01:r_13c2ae299018c9ee.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Holding yourself to a high standard
　is fine. Risking your life
　to atone is fine as well.」

stage0500_01:r_6f4f8dd80820f5e7.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「This title of ace pilot is
　the result of those efforts.
　At least let me say that.」

stage0500_01:r_afa513b4815df4c9.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「...I see.
　You have my thanks, $$ＡＧ$$.」

stage0500_01:r_6cf1e5ed68d98bd4.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
（People who wear masks and
　have younger sisters really do
　seem to think alike.）

stage0500_01:r_e62eb587b8d34cb9.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
（I hope $$ゼクス$$, and those
　other two, can all reunite happily
　with their sisters someday...）

stage0500_01:r_f89f6c6c4b076e16.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Wouldn't you have become an ace
　sooner if you hadn't held back
　for $$ゼクス$$?」

stage0500_01:r_b43bdba9393d4d68.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I know you're always letting
　$$ゼクス$$ take the lead, $$ノイン$$.」

stage0500_01:r_3ec159d1a3492877.text:
$$ノイン$$
「I do it because I want to.
　I don't expect anyone to understand.」

stage0500_01:r_4e2fbafa9ebef558.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「How admirable, $$ノイン$$.
　Then today, let me at least
　offer you my congratulations.」

stage0500_01:r_bde2e27bac7e3317.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Thank you for all your
　tireless work, $$ノイン$$.」

stage0500_01:r_0cd6aab432ee5af7.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
（I'm sure she gives $$ゼクス$$
　that same smile when he thanks her.
　How lovely, $$ノイン$$...）

stage0500_01:r_df10ad0a71c307da.text:
$$ヒルデ$$
「Me, an ace pilot?
　It feels like a dream...」

stage0500_01:r_9293c52555ba1457.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Not at all. This is the reward
　for all your hard work, $$ヒルデ$$.」

stage0500_01:r_6c41647935e2574a.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Even I take my hat off to you,
　$$ヒルデ$$. You've mastered
　even the Zero System.」

stage0500_01:r_ca702b5726ebd4da.text:
$$ヒルデ$$
「Thanks, $$ＡＧ$$.
　I'll... I'll keep doing my best.」

stage0500_01:r_51ce1d8caa34c103.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Just don't push yourself too hard.
　Well... With the God of Death guarding
　you, I'm sure you'll be fine.」

stage0500_01:r_c6937f14a8985c35.text:
$$シン$$
「I don't wear this $$赤服|lc$$
　just for show, you know.」

stage0500_01:r_07513334490fbdf9.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「A red coat... of bean paste?
　So you're a rice cake, then.」

stage0500_01:r_d90c4affdd742a0e.text:
$$シン$$
「Sure. I'd like to think I've
　got the skill and pride to go with it.」

stage0500_01:r_082a55c75a163780.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「A proud tradition, passed down...
　But it's a little too sweet.
　Especially that dark bean paste...」

stage0500_01:r_fa09fad95980b867.text:
$$シン$$
「Hold it! I know I still have
　a lot to learn. Like you said,
　I've nearly fallen into darkness before.」

stage0500_01:r_f5507082e5c31362.text:
$$シン$$
「But I'm going to keep
　fighting alongside my friends.」

stage0500_01:r_d23d30b65284f69d.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...We seem a little out of sync,
　but never mind. In any case,
　congratulations, $$シン$$!」

stage0500_01:r_b69df689192adfc2.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You've done so well, even without
　your partner $$アスラン$$ here.」

stage0500_01:r_8a9ac301023aa8d3.text:
$$キラ$$
「$$アスラン$$ is doing his part...
　$$シン$$ is fighting without $$ルナマリア$$...
　So I have to fight on my own too.」

stage0500_01:r_e4ae97a37c9b0cce.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「How admirable, $$キラ$$.
　A classic hero through and through!」

stage0500_01:r_38f89a2d27debb9e.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「With both $$アスラン$$ and $$シン$$,
　you fought all-out, then shook hands.
　That's a classic boys' manga plot!」

stage0500_01:r_e418ba9e04898c28.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It's wonderful that you can become
　friends with people you've fought.」

stage0500_01:r_f79b2ac118e41c1a.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
（With that kind heart of yours,
　I'm sure you can overcome
　the high walls you'll face ahead.）

stage0500_01:r_9bf1948e282e5587.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「W-what is it?
　Why that intense stare...!?」

stage0500_01:r_67c9e002d64d9781.text:
$$刹那$$
「This is a good chance to ask.
　Just... what are you?」

stage0500_01:r_cb5e5d90104f7a88.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「W-what am I...?
　I'm $$ＡＧ$$, an agent robot
　of $$ＤＥＭ$$ Corporation...」

stage0500_01:r_34f8d5cbd504c416.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then let me ask you in turn.
　What are you?」

stage0500_01:r_0a597f4cd9c8309b.text:
$$刹那$$
「I am $$刹那・Ｆ・セイエイ$$...
　A Gundam Meister of Celestial Being.」

stage0500_01:r_fc7afc4ebf9fd013.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You're not going to say
　'I am Gundam'?」

stage0500_01:r_833975ddd032dd18.text:
$$刹那$$
「I am myself.
　I simply do what I can
　as an individual human being.」

stage0500_01:r_1608d4c4d3f78b24.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
（Such conviction...
　$$刹那$$ truly has
　gone beyond Gundam.）

stage0500_01:r_149109e3b1cf253b.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
（Though it's a shame
　I didn't get to hear the famous line...）

stage0500_01:r_56d65b2dba1b5061.text:
$$ロックオン$$
「Don't worry about that.
　Believe it or not, I'm a one-woman man.」

stage0500_01:r_7d1683c9b3b3094a.text:
$$ロックオン$$
「...Sounds like somebody
　told you about her...」

stage0500_01:r_3f3b91470236b2a8.text:
$$ロックオン$$
「No need to worry about me.」

stage0500_01:r_1a6f62daa82363ae.text:
$$ロックオン$$
「Sure, we can't see each other
　easily, but I email her regularly.」

stage0500_01:r_9d80dc88f241858b.text:
$$ロックオン$$
「Don't go killing off my girl.
　She's at the Celestial Being
　base on Jupiter.」

stage0500_01:r_23cb7be357e8a4e0.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'm terribly sorry!
　I was sure she had passed away...!」

stage0500_01:r_60cd511150394b50.text:
$$ロックオン$$
「Well... I guess that was
　how it was supposed to turn out...」

stage0500_01:r_33e42009af9a0b54.text:
$$ロックオン$$
「But we managed to save her
　at the very last second.
　We beat fate.」

stage0500_01:r_7fc1d3642481712b.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You're absolutely right.
　I look forward to seeing
　your continued success, $$ロックオン$$.」

stage0500_01:r_7d0527803c131a6e.text:
$$アレルヤ$$
「Thank you, $$ＡＧ$$.
　But I didn't do it all on my own.」

stage0500_01:r_9d4ee24cdaa2851d.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Quite right. I must congratulate
　your co-pilot $$マリー$$... Or rather,
　$$ピーリス$$, as well.」

stage0500_01:r_003ee7d177c348cf.text:
$$ハレルヤ$$
「Hey, $$ＡＧ$$!
　Ignoring me on purpose, are you?」

stage0500_01:r_f4f785c3e285cb39.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Not at all, $$ハレルヤ$$.
　Of course I'm aware of you.」

stage0500_01:r_eb4bb0599c61e2b2.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The relationship between you
　and $$ハレルヤ$$ is
　extremely interesting to me as well.」

stage0500_01:r_6f761a8fd9d1f7b4.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「This could raise one hell-elu-jah
　of a row. Let's change the subject
　and clear the air. Hallelujah!」

stage0500_01:r_98c6e74747c3936c.text:
$$ハレルヤ$$
「Quit it with the lousy puns!」

stage0500_01:r_290faeefba2fe68d.text:
$$ティエリア$$
「Having someone celebrate
　my achievement like this
　isn't a bad feeling.」

stage0500_01:r_bbc100b0424fdcd0.text:
$$ティエリア$$
「I'm an $$イノベイド$$.
　I don't have people
　celebrating my birthday.」

stage0500_01:r_8ca795c4c35fc911.text:
$$ティエリア$$
「Of course. You're a robot.」

stage0500_01:r_69bf15620a355d50.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But I do have a heart.
　Just like you, $$ティエリア$$.」

stage0500_01:r_5557ccda2f7c3f23.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「Thanks, $$ＡＧ$$. It's been ages
　since anyone congratulated me.」

stage0500_01:r_48a3f23147fd6b6d.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「I'm past the age where those
　are much cause for celebration.」

stage0500_01:r_ae273a5479d64978.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh... But if you got married,
　all sorts of people
　would congratulate you!」

stage0500_01:r_28066ae0934e6411.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「That's even harder to imagine.」

stage0500_01:r_a38016b9c3d59e6e.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「What a shame...
　If I were human, I'd propose
　to you right away, $$スメラギ$$.」

stage0500_01:r_9d00ee0ac3902eac.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh... If a robot would do,
　I'll fetch the marriage papers
　this very instant.」

stage0500_01:r_258a09e5e9761e3d.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「I'm sorry, $$ＡＧ$$.
　Human or robot,
　that's not going to happen.」

stage0500_01:r_4a301748a7930689.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「Hehe... You're not husband material,
　but I do appreciate you
　celebrating with me. Thanks, $$ＡＧ$$.」

stage0500_01:r_e5630cc47dc440b7.text:
$$グラハム$$
「This is about all I can do now.」

stage0500_01:r_8f39e18936c36a15.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Please don't belittle yourself.
　You're a member of $c now.」

stage0500_01:r_f2655371e3ef7b59.text:
$$グラハム$$
「True... I won't forget my past,
　but dwelling on it forever
　would be unseemly too.」

stage0500_01:r_ee7f46e6a631fd5c.text:
$$グラハム$$
「I will live to the fullest,
　so I can take pride in who I am now.」

stage0500_01:r_959b2fde0469959d.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The way of the warrior is death...
　But having survived, you've found
　a new way to live, $$グラハム$$.」

stage0500_01:r_586ac0e9503b5765.text:
$$グラハム$$
（Yes... To repay the man
　who opened the way
　to a new life for me as well.）

stage0500_01:r_95a0cdf4151c12f7.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Happy Ace Pilot!
　Congratulations, $$コーラサワー$$!」

stage0500_01:r_10cbf30c54cfe4fc.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Happy Ace Pilot!
　Congratulations, $$コーラサワー$$ the Happy!」

stage0500_01:r_d84831042f10325c.text:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Okay!
　That's the one!」

stage0500_01:r_cc01b694a39de719.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Haha... You really are
　a happy man, aren't you?」

stage0500_01:r_6a5a0a8d6d6a68fd.text:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Sure am.
　But I'm not stopping here.」

stage0500_01:r_fa54b106906131ec.text:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Next after ace is top ace!
　I'm going to become
　the best pilot in $c!」

stage0500_01:r_c98d1f9a0e601947.text:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Then the Colonel... I mean,
　the Brigadier will praise me.
　'Well done, Patrick,' she'll say.」

stage0500_01:r_afa4e4bac1376010.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You really are happy.
　I can only envy you.」

stage0500_01:r_447e23c61fa29c56.text:
$$オットー$$
「Mm... To think a captain like me
　would receive the title of ace.」

stage0500_01:r_d95bdcd1bd8b6579.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Many people recognize your recent
　achievements, $$オットー$$. I'm sure
　your crew feels the same way.」

stage0500_01:r_2b4d4dced3ef5a03.text:
$$オットー$$
「I wonder... My first officer
　has seen me make a fool
　of myself quite often...」

stage0500_01:r_d3ea963a3518a978.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That's all in the past.
　You're a fine captain now, $$オットー$$.」

stage0500_01:r_0c888ad00ef30dc4.text:
$$オットー$$
「With things as they are,
　I intend to fulfill
　my own role as best I can.」

stage0500_01:r_941d9e3a330b1087.text:
$$オットー$$
「Both I and the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$
　have come too far to turn back now.」

stage0500_01:r_b23f4e273f76c5a8.text:
$$バナージ$$
「I've still got a long way to go.
　I'm practically relying on
　the Unicorn's performance to fight.」

stage0500_01:r_2488b984097a7bdf.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「All the Gundam pilots
　before you were like that.」

stage0500_01:r_0491c741ae20f5e6.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But along the way, they found
　their own answers and turned
　those answers into strength.」

stage0500_01:r_131bea3d5d957e98.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Could I... do that too...?」

stage0500_01:r_fc994d6aae0712cc.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That's up to you, $$バナージ$$.
　Only you can awaken the god...
　the possibility within yourself.」

stage0500_01:r_18ef8ab6be368d72.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Thank you, $$ＡＧ$$.
　I'll... give it a try.」

stage0500_01:r_176fd2544c64e83e.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'll be expecting great things, $$バナージ$$.」

stage0500_01:r_ae2ea53f43e74074.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
（Laplace's Box could decide humanity's fate...
　And you are its key.）

stage0500_01:r_d4f3fe1e9bcf2590.text:
$$リディ$$
「I've still got a long way to go.
　Calling myself an ace would be presumptuous.」

stage0500_01:r_59cb6a337266e5c9.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh, come now...!
　You say that, but haven't you been
　feeling rather more confident lately?」

stage0500_01:r_521653467873650f.text:
$$リディ$$
「But it's true I've got a long way to go.
　That's why I'll keep aiming higher and higher.」

stage0500_01:r_aab85855cbaf5596.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Keep at it, $$リディ$$.
　As long as you keep that honest attitude,
　I'm sure you'll keep improving.」

stage0500_01:r_46c21ad643c64977.text:
$$リディ$$
「Maybe I have...
　I'm not who I used to be anymore.」

stage0500_01:r_6a27ef5c3933ffa2.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Just one word of advice...
　Whatever your circumstances,
　your own will is what can change them.」

stage0500_01:r_1be6bea3e5d25074.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
（This isn't good...
　This looks like it will take some time...）

stage0500_01:r_243595675818fcae.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「An $$エコーズ$$ man like me, an ace pilot...」

stage0500_01:r_61c5480dbf2e58e0.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Of course! Just what I'd expect of you.
　You command $$エコーズ$$, after all,
　ready to fight wherever duty calls.」

stage0500_01:r_ddda297a7997c73b.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「$$ダグザ$$...
　Are you not used to being praised?」

stage0500_01:r_02c89111c680d125.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「Maybe not.
　I've earned my share of battle honors,
　but I haven't had much experience with praise.」

stage0500_01:r_22a2d3667e5a9fc8.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「And if this information should leak...
　You understand, don't you?」

stage0500_01:r_62e68b17a29fb53b.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Y-yes!
　I'm not ready to die yet!」

stage0500_01:r_98e716ed18b1b3a2.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「I have mixed feelings.
　To be celebrated like this while on secondment...」

stage0500_01:r_91a4ece3cc02badd.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Let's not be so rigid about that.
　You're part of $c now, $$マリーダ$$.」

stage0500_01:r_e83ac0db54ff2b02.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「How about some ice cream to celebrate?」

stage0500_01:r_bc5b33fbc100b97b.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「H-how do you know what I like...!?」

stage0500_01:r_f2d72b948cc38cfe.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「A dimensional merchant's information network.
　Here you are, $$マリーダ$$.」

stage0500_01:r_3b207a6e3b8e5700.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「Thank you.
　I'll gladly accept.」

stage0500_01:r_718d4f86b37b2915.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
（Thank you, too.
　That smile is a treasure.）

stage0500_01:r_444bfe868b096710.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「With $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$'s power,
　this is only to be expected.」

stage0500_01:r_864ee68806b41af1.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh... such confidence.
　Just what I'd expect from Team D's boss.」

stage0500_01:r_5c69712b1b3fb77b.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「Wild power sleeps within everyone's heart.
　Mine is no exception.」

stage0500_01:r_1054a335fa977a7a.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I see...
　I'll use them myself when I get the chance.」

stage0500_01:r_1795607640d74fdb.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「Then I'll leave D-Trader in your hands.」

stage0500_01:r_1efac5b6d8fb1238.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「As a champion racer, $$葵$$,
　aren't you used to this sort of thing?」

stage0500_01:r_63bcb74b5bb605c9.text:
$$葵$$
「Not really...
　I wouldn't compare racing to fighting,
　but this feeling is something special.」

stage0500_01:r_b661c876eb7a4d72.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Of course it is.
　You're being congratulated by yours truly.」

stage0500_01:r_99128140e453d460.text:
$$葵$$
「Then... how about a more intimate celebration,
　just the two of us?」

stage0500_01:r_3e40a7aae6a7ebad.text:
$$葵$$
「Just kidding.
　Sorry, but if someone isn't nice to hold,
　I'll pass.」

stage0500_01:r_d4488f1ef5175d87.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ugh...
　Please wait until I'm reborn as a human...」

stage0500_01:r_4f98756e8506f766.text:
$$葵$$
「Too bad.
　By then, I'll be well beyond
　just being an old lady.」

stage0500_01:r_e18660f45e2bdaae.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「At least I've managed to fulfill my duty
　as Diamond Force's captain.」

stage0500_01:r_c01f3d97d765f442.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Diamond is a fitting squadron name
　for someone as unbending as you, $$ガムリン$$.」

stage0500_01:r_f2a506c32c68b595.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「Maybe so.
　Still, even that makes me happy to hear.」

stage0500_01:r_366eed12d0fa7297.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You really do love Diamond Force, don't you?」

stage0500_01:r_db902169b0ec12e0.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「This is the perfect opportunity.
　Why not celebrate becoming an ace
　by giving your loved one a diamond?」

stage0500_01:r_bccb0c4cb58aa146.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Good grief...
　When it comes to romance,
　you never seem to get past the rookie stage...」

stage0500_01:r_d85829b2f9bff450.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah... I thought you might dislike that title.
　Then let me try again...」

stage0500_01:r_85121e18387bbee9.text:
$$バサラ$$
「I don't care what anyone thinks!
　I'll keep singing until my sound gets through!」

stage0500_01:r_3d395121b4205722.text:
$$アルト$$
「Well...
　This is just another step along the way.」

stage0500_01:r_9496bdb991cf236a.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You say that, but you look rather happy.」

stage0500_01:r_980e935235423ee4.text:
$$アルト$$
「Yeah.
　Even if it's just another step,
　it's proof of everything I've done so far.」

stage0500_01:r_dc9b1e7f62a8afc8.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You usually act so grown-up, $$アルト$$,
　but sometimes you show a boyish side.」

stage0500_01:r_d243a6836b127987.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Not at all.
　That contrast must be what
　so many women find irresistible.」

stage0500_01:r_0e1caed2ba333f4e.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I think I'll follow your example, $$アルト$$,
　and show off my boyish side.」

stage0500_01:r_06e36bd71f54f272.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Wah, wah!
　Mama! Mama! I want milk!」

stage0500_01:r_a9e024bdcd6975b2.text:
$$アルト$$
「That's not a boy, that's a baby!」

stage0500_01:r_978bd43401f7be8a.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Thank you for your usual fiery retort!」

stage0500_01:r_4cb558f092561fde.text:
$$オズマ$$
「Yeah.
　As Skull Squadron's captain,
　I have to be able to manage at least this much.」

stage0500_01:r_119dbefe27cdac46.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Spoken with true authority!
　A man worthy of the Skull Leader name!」

stage0500_01:r_e174d36b825c4290.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now then, $$オズマ$$, let me tell you
　about $$ランカ$$'s latest scandal.」

stage0500_01:r_160384a0c68215c6.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...You're far too shaken up by a joke.
　You're a big brother before you're an ace,
　after all.」

stage0500_01:r_577385dbd6d74922.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But a word of advice.
　You're an ace and a brother,
　but don't forget you're also a man.」

stage0500_01:r_204e41a08c5ec720.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'm sure $$キャシー$$ has a pineapple cake
　ready to celebrate.
　I suggest bringing home a bouquet.」

stage0500_01:r_c1cddb7853813703.text:
$$オズマ$$
「You're right.
　I'll remember what you said, $$ＡＧ$$.」

stage0500_01:r_3569c3ca91ae0f9d.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah... but if it's pineapple salad,
　don't eat it under any circumstances!
　Unless you don't value your life, that is.」

stage0500_01:r_c8c3a682c9917367.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Your sniping skills just keep getting
　sharper, $$ミシェル$$.」

stage0500_01:r_f612b6b60810e300.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「Yeah.
　Whether it's enemies or girls,
　I'd like to hit the mark every time.」

stage0500_01:r_09068a6fd74f79b7.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...But, $$ミシェル$$...
　A sniper's worst enemy is complacency.」

stage0500_01:r_4ff0d278b79d1168.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Remember that especially with easy targets,
　or ones you're sure you can hit.」

stage0500_01:r_b101d62bbac1b33b.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「What's up, $$ＡＧ$$?
　You're awfully serious today.」

stage0500_01:r_05b808b1583f5be2.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「'Don't assume your childhood friend
　will always be there.' Consider that motto
　another gift to celebrate your ace status.」

stage0500_01:r_6bdc8a8243c655ed.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「Got it, $$ＡＧ$$.
　I'll get back to basics once in a while
　and aim at the target closest to me.」

stage0500_01:r_1c9bf7ffbf9314a5.text:
$$ルカ$$
「Coming this far even in a support role
　is a real boost to my confidence.」

stage0500_01:r_f581e32ff0b84e01.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Brains enough to skip grades, a cute baby face,
　a rich family, a girlfriend with a great figure,
　and now the title of ace pilot...」

stage0500_01:r_b251d2d3a7cdba85.text:
$$ルカ$$
「What am I supposed to say to that...?」

stage0500_01:r_abc1d4645695a0e0.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then a question.
　Of all these blessings, $$ルカ$$,
　what do you cherish most?」

stage0500_01:r_ee41ea400d1ee0bf.text:
$$ルカ$$
「Oh, right.
　I have to tell Nanase I've become an ace pilot.」

stage0500_01:r_eb56670c83981cc6.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「A woman you'd give up everything to protect...
　How enviable.」

stage0500_01:r_8d5dbaa0f1e069de.text:
$$クラン$$
「We Zentrans are a warrior race.
　I've merely shown a fraction of our strength.」

stage0500_01:r_7accc1b1cfd86010.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I see...
　And that warrior race discovered culture
　and now coexists with Miclones.」

stage0500_01:r_301d85713d2cddd7.text:
$$クラン$$
「Exactly.
　And I'm proud to be one of them.」

stage0500_01:r_b77f3e5c390fe067.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I speak a little Zentradi, too, you know.
　So, to celebrate your becoming an ace,
　I'd like a little demonstration of culture.」

stage0500_01:r_16141de28d738543.text:
$$クラン$$
「Y-you can't just ask me to...!」

stage0500_01:r_39d8b5a2657c65a4.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh... you can't kiss on your own, can you?
　...Shall I call $$ミシェル$$?」

stage0500_01:r_5dcadcd6c77bc7dc.text:
$$カナリア$$
「I only did my duty.」

stage0500_01:r_f22e056851da9461.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I see.
　A mother's strength knows no bounds.」

stage0500_01:r_97923e3dd5dae64b.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「W-what is it?
　Such a passionate gaze...
　But you have a husband, $$カナリア$$...」

stage0500_01:r_c8b34405ed7bfde7.text:
$$カナリア$$
「Don't get the wrong idea.
　I'm only interested in what's inside you.」

stage0500_01:r_93b46e3c24ed4825.text:
$$カナリア$$
「Your AI is on par with a human mind.
　I simply want to know what gave rise
　to such a twisted psyche.」

stage0500_01:r_d7cd6f0e351ca403.text:
$$カナリア$$
「I'd like to try counseling you.
　Come see me when you have time.」

stage0500_01:r_4b3e91da51d87c72.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah... ahaha...
　Please go easy on me when I do.」

stage0500_01:r_49dde825db6b02a0.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Ace pilot...
　That takes me back.」

stage0500_01:r_5d3ee1804aedfa48.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh, I know all about it.
　You were once quite the renowned
　Valkyrie pilot, $$ジェフリー$$.」

stage0500_01:r_7fd3cd80460fefb1.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「I doubt I'll fly a Valkyrie again,
　but I still ride the waves.」

stage0500_01:r_b99c671eb373edd1.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh, the space surfer himself!
　Forever young!」

stage0500_01:r_0f9b6f684aa8f438.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
（That must be what has $$モニカ$$ so smitten...）

stage0500_01:r_a671f14759794503.text:
$$竜馬$$
「An ace after just 80 kills? Not enough for me.
　I've got to take down at least 100.」

stage0500_01:r_ed9690679f1aa20f.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Just watch, $$ＡＧ$$.
　I'm aiming big. I'll take down 1,000.」

stage0500_01:r_121b55dcb47984aa.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The scary part is that when you say it,
　$$竜馬$$, it doesn't sound like a joke.」

stage0500_01:r_0c472072ac8bda60.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Better hope you're not one of that 1,000.」

stage0500_01:r_8e2f92d078970a2b.text:
$$隼人$$
「Heh... Not much for the enemy
　to be happy about or celebrate.」

stage0500_01:r_e8ecfd162319c1e6.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now, now.
　The ideal man is harsh with his enemies
　and kind to his own.」

stage0500_01:r_5c0f74cc35812a77.text:
$$隼人$$
「Naive.
　That attitude won't keep you alive
　in the times ahead.」

stage0500_01:r_0bb68446ec330a05.text:
$$隼人$$
「The weak won't survive what's coming...
　That's why I'll be hard on our own people too.」

stage0500_01:r_8e1ebf6b0c149f4b.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I-I suppose that's another form of kindness. Yes.」

stage0500_01:r_86f0e9b721a4f655.text:
$$隼人$$
「I thought I'd start by beating some decency
　into you. What do you say?」

stage0500_01:r_271fbb35b579a866.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「A truly mature response!
　Just what I'd expect from
　the Getter Team's conscience!」

stage0500_01:r_b40fe3d3e6f2b1d9.text:
$$弁慶$$
「Well, yeah.
　$$竜馬$$ still hasn't grown up,
　and $$隼人$$ is too cold.」

stage0500_01:r_778c6eb2f5afc622.text:
$$弁慶$$
「I guess I'm the only sensible one
　on the Getter Team.」

stage0500_01:r_3fb74a41e682c7de.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then I can ask you, $$弁慶$$.
　Please let me have $$渓$$...」

stage0500_01:r_d1b8cb87f8ea00d6.text:
$$弁慶$$
「As long as I'm alive, no no-good men
　or robots are getting anywhere near $$渓$$!
　Got that, $$ＡＧ$$!?」

stage0500_01:r_3c39aed29379134c.text:
$$號$$
「Our fight goes on...
　I have no intention of stopping here.」

stage0500_01:r_bff5468c57365d6b.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I thought you'd say that.
　Then let me cheer you on, $$號$$,
　as you set out for an endless battle.」

stage0500_01:r_173107393504e4d1.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Um... being ignored here really does hurt...」

stage0500_01:r_0d848a222f69347d.text:
$$甲児$$
「I've got a long way to go, $$ＡＧ$$.
　This is just another step along the way.」

stage0500_01:r_bd5c0088c2d22ef6.text:
$$甲児$$
「I'll keep fighting until peace returns...
　If that's what it takes, I'll knock down
　a hundred enemies, or a thousand.」

stage0500_01:r_77fc21c69be0890c.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Your resolve is quite clear.
　...You've grown a lot since your days
　as Atami's shadow gang boss.」

stage0500_01:r_a0fcf4d8788a2bce.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh, but I've been meaning to hear
　all about your exploits back then.」

stage0500_01:r_d8483ee925825d04.text:
$$甲児$$
「Knock it off...!
　That's all in the past!」

stage0500_01:r_dae622560a4cfc83.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Don't be so modest.
　Please, do tell...!」

stage0500_01:r_aa09da82b4c52a2a.text:
$$甲児$$
「...Do you really want to hear it?」

stage0500_01:r_ced1bbcf059b07d7.text:
$$さやか$$
「Oh... sorry.
　When I saw you approaching, $$ＡＧ$$,
　I got a little wary...」

stage0500_01:r_dda2f4922920a4e0.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「How could you...
　I only wanted to congratulate you...」

stage0500_01:r_20cd18288d206a35.text:
$$さやか$$
「I'm really sorry.
　I was getting ahead of myself...」

stage0500_01:r_683f2ca0d6804be4.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Not at all.
　A beautiful girl like you, $$さやか$$,
　can never be too careful.」

stage0500_01:r_da78018881956191.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Such modesty.
　Your charm captivates not only $c,
　but even the enemy.」

stage0500_01:r_4267b07b216d5d90.text:
$$さやか$$
「Thank you.
　And for congratulating me on becoming an ace.」

stage0500_01:r_1a9b7326b53f45cc.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Of course!
　And as an extra prize for becoming an ace,
　a full-body massage from your humble $$ＡＧ$$!」

stage0500_01:r_02b69055356d9cfb.text:
$$さやか$$
「You had something dirty in mind after all!」

stage0500_01:r_0b8e88db1a9dd44e.text:
$$ボス$$
「Yeah!
　Take a good look at $$ボス$$ in all his glory!」

stage0500_01:r_a4798a17c691a81a.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well, well... $$ボス$$, known as $c's
　jokester, comedian and comic relief...
　Who'd have thought you'd become an ace?」

stage0500_01:r_31f18ff9dc8f076e.text:
$$ボス$$
「Hold it!
　Who's been saying that!?」

stage0500_01:r_3cf33f3773748d0f.text:
$$ボス$$
「Don't talk like your own prejudices
　are what the whole squad thinks!」

stage0500_01:r_533e554662b8c631.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now, now...
　I think of you as a kindred spirit, $$ボス$$.」

stage0500_01:r_b06b2a23a76e8ce4.text:
$$ボス$$
「That's the worst part of all!」

stage0500_01:r_ef91c7636fe8aad4.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「Nothing... I was considering
　what sort of living being you are.」

stage0500_01:r_f2effcece0132e9d.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「How are you different from me,
　with my body of steel?」

stage0500_01:r_f7c5d0246e396cd5.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「When you put it that way, you're right...」

stage0500_01:r_7aa9edfa8692bb8d.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「Exactly.
　You and I are much the same.
　Let us fight together for justice.」

stage0500_01:r_994d9e1d2a462e94.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Haha... I never imagined I'd hear
　the god of light of Olympus
　say such a thing to me.」

stage0500_01:r_96474b2c3a6e7165.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It pains me to tell you this
　when you're smiling so brightly, $$赤木$$...」

stage0500_01:r_5bf2ab7960121e96.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'm sorry.
　I haven't prepared any commemorative gifts
　for becoming an ace.」

stage0500_01:r_023f1f7532dd508f.text:
$$赤木$$
「Don't worry about it.
　We don't fight for that sort of thing.」

stage0500_01:r_3a4a5d03e079f53d.text:
$$赤木$$
「Heroes don't ask for anything in return!
　That's a timeless rule.」

stage0500_01:r_037dafa5c5124420.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I see...
　Then I'll pass those words along to
　President $$大河内$$ of $$２１世紀警備保障$$.」

stage0500_01:r_87d57a77ad22ca35.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「My, free labor... What a surprise.
　Saving an employee's entire salary
　will surely delight the management.」

stage0500_01:r_88aa7aea54616b53.text:
$$赤木$$
「W-wait a minute!
　That's not what I meant!!」

stage0500_01:r_8e980fa9b6fbb694.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Thank you, $$ＡＧ$$.
　I never expected words of congratulation
　from you.」

stage0500_01:r_6a06cc16f6683240.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh, no... The words of a paltry robot
　like me must be worthless to you,
　$$ロジャー$$ the Negotiator...」

stage0500_01:r_e2efb08e47011ced.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Don't belittle yourself.
　Excessive modesty becomes an insult
　to the person you're speaking to.」

stage0500_01:r_d1f368432258ec05.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Besides, I believe in treating everyone equally.
　Being a robot is no reason to mistreat you.」

stage0500_01:r_7317f048fc262114.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'll paint myself black!
　Then I'd like to serve you, $$ロジャー$$!」

stage0500_01:r_3efe6b08505e6b39.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Unfortunately, I have enough robot assistants.
　But I appreciate the thought.」

stage0500_01:r_807f7b4a12c3c6ab.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「My role is tactical command.
　There was no need for me to become an ace.」

stage0500_01:r_857468de19815523.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But doesn't it feel good to use
　overwhelming power to make
　'tactics overturn strategy'?」

stage0500_01:r_72f66f82d72a5e2c.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「Indeed...
　I can just picture the loser's frustration.」

stage0500_01:r_ac913a939029996b.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I imagine you're smirking behind that mask,
　but 'Do not do unto others
　what you would not wish done unto yourself.'」

stage0500_01:r_31efa01531be032d.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Still, $$ゼロ$$,
　I do respect that mean streak of yours.」

stage0500_01:r_8455446770647f64.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「That means very little coming from you.」

stage0500_01:r_bc321459e2182228.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Don't you wish you could attend
　$$陣代高校$$ too, $$スザク$$,
　and join the Volunteer Club?」

stage0500_01:r_92a92fbd8a2b734e.text:
$$スザク$$
「But I have to atone.
　To everyone in the world.」

stage0500_01:r_05ebe641ed2da125.text:
$$スザク$$
「That's the path $$ゼロ$$ and I chose.」

stage0500_01:r_9164bd75a5c29894.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
（A steep, endless path...
　May you both find peace someday...）

stage0500_01:r_bd55bb9029e467d1.text:
$$カレン$$
「You're congratulating me?
　Isn't there some catch?」

stage0500_01:r_18c345e4b68c12c7.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I congratulated you because
　I wanted to make you happy, $$カレン$$...
　And that's how you respond...」

stage0500_01:r_265114998c9cdda8.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It's all right...
　I have only my usual behavior to blame...」

stage0500_01:r_1e07f9d18fe0f887.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then, as an apology, please try on
　this bunny suit I got you
　to celebrate becoming an ace.」

stage0500_01:r_5f7d81050a6eb0d2.text:
$$カレン$$
「There was a catch after all!!」

stage0500_01:r_d1593dddba79767f.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Congratulations... huh.
　Not a word that suits either of us.」

stage0500_01:r_f3d13455fde20d76.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Don't be so cold, $$ＡＧ$$.
　You and I are much alike.」

stage0500_01:r_d940e68fde96e892.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh... then should I change my name to 'A.G.'?」

stage0500_01:r_d4539352ead4c516.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「That would be pointless.
　Treasure your own name.」

stage0500_01:r_3a86021bb5195379.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...Ah, thank you.
　Though I'm not sure I understand...」

stage0500_01:r_112c133deaee5282.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「As glum as ever, I see.
　You've become an ace, after all.
　You could look a little happier...」

stage0500_01:r_8075f8bcc76f7df8.text:
$$宗介$$
「A good soldier is not one who defeats many foes.
　It is one who completes the assigned mission.」

stage0500_01:r_ce4876c69922ab65.text:
$$宗介$$
「The enemies one soldier can defeat are
　negligible compared to a strategic weapon.」

stage0500_01:r_e1a3d4cb622d1379.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「So that's your philosophy as a mercenary,
　$$宗介$$.」

stage0500_01:r_f9c80ffd03c02dbb.text:
$$宗介$$
「But being congratulated is not unpleasant.
　You have my thanks, $$ＡＧ$$.」

stage0500_01:r_947f475c9b344398.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You're welcome, $$宗介$$.
　I'll keep awaiting your safe return,
　a soldier's most important mission.」

stage0500_01:r_2809477b354952d7.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
（Oh dear...
　It seems my timing was poor.）

stage0500_01:r_70e2d7c09c997d80.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
（$$宗介$$...
　I'll be waiting for the day you recover.）

stage0500_01:r_37ddf9facc0bf611.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Thanks, $$ＡＧ$$.
　So, where's the bunny girl presenting the prize?」

stage0500_01:r_731c9dd791416eab.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah... so that's what you'd like after all?」

stage0500_01:r_6d64b6e7f8b0364d.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Of course.
　...But let me make this clear.
　No dressing yourself up in a bunny suit.」

stage0500_01:r_b3edb5df8a517f28.text:
$$クルツ$$
「What's with that pause!?
　Don't tell me you were seriously...!」

stage0500_01:r_b6bf9ce8b93b16bb.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「What a shame...
　I've been dieting all this time
　just so I could wear the bunny suit...」

stage0500_01:r_ed2ebfef41991018.text:
$$クルツ$$
「That's the kind of joke where
　I don't even know where to start...」

stage0500_01:r_d51e9ed1fd8496c5.text:
$$マオ$$
「One gift beats a thousand words.
　What's the prize?」

stage0500_01:r_2f8e597bcc3abc88.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Was my first thought. But you prefer quality
　over quantity, $$マオ$$, so instead I'll give you
　wine worth about the same amount.」

stage0500_01:r_7ae9b8fbbedf5dee.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Let's savor it together at a restaurant
　with a lovely view of the city at night.」

stage0500_01:r_2bb1d8407f3ac7af.text:
$$マオ$$
「S-Sorry, $$ＡＧ$$...
　I'm afraid I'll have to pass.」

stage0500_01:r_c7924874296909f6.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Why!? Is it because I'm a short, squat,
　sexually harassing robot comedian!?」

stage0500_01:r_61dc876016accae5.text:
$$マオ$$
「N-Nothing good ever happens when I drink
　anything other than beer.」

stage0500_01:r_91c57ff6966efb70.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「What's that supposed to mean!?
　Are you saying drinking wine with me
　is a bad thing!?」

stage0500_01:r_df305a2342916c62.text:
$$マオ$$
「A-Anyway, sorry!
　I'll have to pass this time!」

stage0500_01:r_e5b6062db98e78ba.text:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Mm...
　It is my duty as $$ウルズ$$ 1.」

stage0500_01:r_ec3afb65f0579128.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The complete World Masterpiece
　Anime Theater disc collection.」

stage0500_01:r_ce2710e169c8638f.text:
$$クルーゾー$$
「B-But it's out of print! The publisher's
　troubles made a reissue hopeless...!」

stage0500_01:r_ec365b30f337a99c.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well, you know... As a dimensional
　merchant, I risk my life to get my stock.」

stage0500_01:r_f0f31573186c8442.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I learned you were fond of these,
　$$クルーゾー$$, so I ordered them for you.」

stage0500_01:r_57f1229a4b0ea6c6.text:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Thank you, $$ＡＧ$$!
　I'll never forget this kindness!」

stage0500_01:r_db2f030e03a681e6.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I understand. Everyone has their secrets.
　I won't breathe a word to anyone else.」

stage0500_01:r_28f133955535cb56.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Hm? What's wrong, Mish $$テッサ$$?
　Why so wary?」

stage0500_01:r_c5d939bf0ab35301.text:
$$テッサ$$
「U-Um... Could you please stop
　calling me 'Mish $$テッサ$$'?」

stage0500_01:r_5ad54bf4c561f917.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「My apologies. 'Miss $$テッサ$$' is
　a bit of a tongue twister...」

stage0500_01:r_ee98c860ad1449b5.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Then you needn't bother with 'Miss.'
　You can be more casual...」

stage0500_01:r_876f8e0c409bcbad.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well... I thought I'd entertain you
　with my sex appeal, $$アマタ$$...」

stage0500_01:r_e9e087ff23d7e995.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now your guard's down, here's the real gift!
　A collection of treasured $c photos,
　chosen with a dimensional merchant's pride!」

stage0500_01:r_8d129a79eba7a963.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah... Such a shame I can't show them
　to anyone else.」

stage0500_01:r_062fb78eb68b379c.text:
$$カイエン$$
「$$ＡＧ$$... You aren't hiding
　some nasty scheme behind those words,
　are you?」

stage0500_01:r_3ab02ea1851738c4.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh, dear...
　You really don't trust me, do you?」

stage0500_01:r_38e88246aad9f576.text:
$$カイエン$$
「You brought it on yourself.」

stage0500_01:r_5358782b9a37a49e.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I understand, $$カイエン$$.
　You're wary of me because you want
　to keep me away from $$ミコノ$$, right?」

stage0500_01:r_47a795a982a2afe8.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Aha, right on the mark!
　You pretend not to care, but you're
　protecting $$ミコノ$$. How admirable.」

stage0500_01:r_e374cf10667cf8ca.text:
$$カイエン$$
「Don't tell the others about this...」

stage0500_01:r_e14592cee4ffa524.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Of course. A secret's best kept secret...
　My lips are sealed.」

stage0500_01:r_8842bb2bfc0f9d13.text:
$$カイエン$$
「Ugh... Letting this thing find my weakness...
　I'll regret this for the rest of my life...」

stage0500_01:r_eb9a86a85a255734.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「Thank you, $$ＡＧ$$.
　I used to be the girl who couldn't do anything.
　It's like a dream that I've come this far.」

stage0500_01:r_1ea0cdc9a509a196.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It's all thanks to your hard work.
　Congratulations on enduring so much
　sexual harassment without giving up!」

stage0500_01:r_7f01e7a12d31b087.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「But you were the one behind
　most of that harassment, $$ＡＧ$$...」

stage0500_01:r_ffcc7a75089467aa.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「An ace pilot shouldn't concern herself
　with such trivial details.」

stage0500_01:r_07c48732ddfefbf4.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Mmm... That pout is so cute, too～」

stage0500_01:r_a72dda11fc49eb97.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
（Oh, that's irresistible...
　I'm starting to envy $$アマタ$$.）

stage0500_01:r_f7a511e04286fdd9.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「This seems a good time to teach you
　a secret hole-digging art I've mastered,
　$$アンディ$$.」

stage0500_01:r_a6286a7903b6a161.text:
$$アンディ$$
「A secret art, $$ＡＧ$$...?
　That sounds pretty suspicious...」

stage0500_01:r_e244e86a736affd3.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「What are you saying!?
　With this art, you can dig
　two holes at the same time!」

stage0500_01:r_2df2e7ca3ea786f3.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Now that IS amazing!
　Tell me, $$ＡＧ$$!」

stage0500_01:r_7c8562a4597f362e.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It isn't easy. First, go to a shrine
　alone at two in the morning.」

stage0500_01:r_f429d9f2e6bc885b.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then, picturing someone you hate,
　drive a long nail into a straw doll...」

stage0500_01:r_bb0c3ffab081cbfa.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Hold it!
　What does that have to do with digging!?」

stage0500_01:r_2b2f5c449b7388b6.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Curse someone, and dig two graves...
　While digging a hole for your enemy,
　you dig a deep, deep one for yourself...」

stage0500_01:r_7452a28564f83d97.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Who'd want an art like that!?」

stage0500_01:r_4f0b0e1d6f879eb9.text:
$$モロイ$$
「$$ＡＧ$$...
　You came all this way to congratulate me?」

stage0500_01:r_839b7c99c4b5c251.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But of course.
　I've always admired your composure,
　$$モロイ$$.」

stage0500_01:r_127f42295b9f4679.text:
$$モロイ$$
「That's nice of you to say.」

stage0500_01:r_8a58bbd8987ebc3e.text:
$$モロイ$$
「But I seem to fade into the background
　here in $c.」

stage0500_01:r_4922506cae1f8e39.text:
$$モロイ$$
「I'm intelligent and mature, yet I have
　the passion of my tropical birthplace.
　Somehow, that doesn't come across.」

stage0500_01:r_4ec43ca60ad8356a.text:
$$モロイ$$
「At $$聖天使学園$$, I was
　reasonably popular and respected...」

stage0500_01:r_125ca40a4a85a7cc.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
（Oh, dear... This could take a while...）

stage0500_01:r_37d872852607b631.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Oh, $$ＡＧ$$. Well... It's not like
　your congratulations make me happy.」

stage0500_01:r_d573a61a7c6e77c8.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now, now, don't say that.
　Since you're here, why not
　have a sniff of me?」

stage0500_01:r_cd70b44379f08f25.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well?
　You won't say I reek worse than vomit,
　will you?」

stage0500_01:r_fabfba3274f2f2ab.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Y-Your smell... I can't figure it out...
　What the hell are you?」

stage0500_01:r_75995a76fa453b28.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ha ha ha... I'm not quite sure myself.」

stage0500_01:r_6b84e8141e5fe83b.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Please don't look so openly bored!
　I went to the trouble of getting
　an $$アリシア$$ disc just for you...」

stage0500_01:r_f85487ee1be2ffb2.text:
$$ジン$$
「No thanks...
　I've moved on from $$アリシア$$.」

stage0500_01:r_37e1fcbc3a3a2927.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「What!? Now you've got a life,
　you don't need the virtual world anymore?
　Is that it!?」

stage0500_01:r_fded5f19f45bd967.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh, fine! You dodged your death flag
　and survived, so go enjoy your life!
　Hmph!」

stage0500_01:r_38d95edaf1b70819.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Thanks, $$ＡＧ$$.
　So, do I get a prize?」

stage0500_01:r_33ed04337f3cf78e.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ouch!
　Such a quick reply leaves me speechless.」

stage0500_01:r_05c5f50295695b83.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Sorry. I like your sense of fun, $$ＡＧ$$,
　but your looks are a bit...」

stage0500_01:r_a40671757953292d.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Urgh...!
　There's nothing I can do about that...!」

stage0500_01:r_cf9ce7c0144e1318.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Ah ha ha...!
　Better luck in your next life!」

stage0500_01:r_ca912cd5a9d973c8.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
（It seems I've come at a bad time...）

stage0500_01:r_366e05ea3153060b.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
（Hang in there, $$ゼシカ$$!
　I'll be waiting for that smile of yours,
　bright as the sun, to return!）

stage0500_01:r_fa62fd44c6b51a86.text:
$$シュレード$$
「Thank you, $$ＡＧ$$. You're like a dectet...
　No, even more than that.」

stage0500_01:r_19113d1696fb6447.text:
$$シュレード$$
「Playing a capriccio...
　Animato and appassionato,
　then con fuoco and brillante.」

stage0500_01:r_5032a1cd3aa4940f.text:
$$シュレード$$
「I mean, you never cease to fascinate me.」

stage0500_01:r_12914309cc6136f9.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I-I don't quite follow,
　but please go easy on me...」

stage0500_01:r_1f61a0813b00740f.text:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「Stop right there, $$ＡＧ$$!
　Don't you come any closer!」

stage0500_01:r_dfe8671018f73da3.text:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「Knowing you, you're about to make
　some crack about the Big Bang
　or Holstein cows, aren't you!?」

stage0500_01:r_aa52842bf20aaaf2.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...You've misunderstood, $$ＭＩＸ$$...
　I only wanted to congratulate you...」

stage0500_01:r_600c7d0fe87964ec.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「No, it's all right.
　I've only myself and my usual behavior
　to blame.」

stage0500_01:r_22143dc61f6b7940.text:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「Because of what happened with my father,
　I have trouble trusting men, and...」

stage0500_01:r_22b7cb71add4aec6.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It's all right, $$ＭＩＸ$$.
　You've recognized that about yourself
　and you're trying to change.」

stage0500_01:r_8e594149d29b2878.text:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「But I still don't feel right about it.」

stage0500_01:r_7d4dca5831226123.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Let me have a good cry against your chest!」

stage0500_01:r_0fc6a5d7d3870f39.text:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「I knew it would come to that!!」

stage0500_01:r_57d44423f79ded80.text:
$$サザンカ$$
「If I get serious, this much is easy! Easy!」

stage0500_01:r_81687351e78825dc.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Indeed.
　You've been quite impressive on the attack
　lately, $$サザンカ$$.」

stage0500_01:r_320885724957e9f3.text:
$$サザンカ$$
「Oh... but I don't only like the giving side.
　I'm a big fan of the receiving side, too.」

stage0500_01:r_d59408df6bc53ba5.text:
$$サザンカ$$
「Not that I'd overlook the giving side.
　You need both giver and receiver, after all.」

stage0500_01:r_6a62ff9d42ad607b.text:
$$サザンカ$$
「The pairing is what matters. Neither one alone
　gets my heart racing.
　It's the world the two of them share...」

stage0500_01:r_34e496c2212b35b2.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Even becoming an ace pilot
　hasn't cured your shyness,
　has it, $$ユノハ$$?」

stage0500_01:r_03fa04536d0c37ec.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「But you're scarier than any enemy, $$ＡＧ$$...」

stage0500_01:r_308c6725893ee10a.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Um... just between us...
　How old are you, $$クレア$$?」

stage0500_01:r_dcd2c3b3b979f4f2.text:
$$クレア$$
「Asking a lady's age?
　You're an even ruder robot than I'd heard.」

stage0500_01:r_d44d99caa74a64be.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Not at all...
　This is purely intellectual curiosity.」

stage0500_01:r_b0e2189d4ffcd7f4.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I have some chocolate doughnuts.
　Would you like one?」

stage0500_01:r_45a5394a3097e806.text:
$$クレア$$
「...Very well.
　I'll make an exception today.」

stage0500_01:r_b504032a98ec0c79.text:
$$クレア$$
「Whether you believe it is up to you.
　Keep it to yourself, please.」

stage0500_01:r_e90cf536b8b45f33.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Y-yes...
　I doubt anyone would believe me anyway...」

stage0500_01:r_5a52284c0ca53653.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Cast into this world alone,
　yet you fight on so bravely, $$ノリコ$$.
　I truly admire you.」

stage0500_01:r_8e7d3966020366f6.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now that you mention it, it does.」

stage0500_01:r_7551112438e2851d.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「Besides, I have $$ガンバスター$$ with me.
　As long as it's here, carrying Big Sis
　and Coach's hopes, I can keep fighting.」

stage0500_01:r_4fd59e7123e561b4.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「I've made things a little somber, haven't I?
　Keep what I just said a secret from the others.」

stage0500_01:r_1b7f27e7368c0728.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Of course!
　Your secret feelings will stay locked away
　in my heart, $$ノリコ$$.」

stage0500_01:r_72939fc214f06cc7.text:
$$シモン$$
「You're congratulating me?
　What's gotten into you?」

stage0500_01:r_3d3b69551494d081.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「How cruel, $$シモン$$.
　I'm a little hurt.」

stage0500_01:r_f725d629f5f08528.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「As an extra prize for becoming an ace,
　I've prepared all sorts of drills for you.」

stage0500_01:r_08cd5d5c77aeea3b.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Kanji drills, math drills, vocabulary drills...
　And here's a mandrill for good measure.」

stage0500_01:r_a593554edfcdfd96.text:
$$シモン$$
「...Are you still mad about what I said earlier?」

stage0500_01:r_f5256315663c326b.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Come on, $$シモン$$!
　Show me your drilling spirit!」

stage0500_01:r_f123990063cfc4a7.text:
$$シモン$$
「If you insist, I'll do it!
　Kanji, math, vocabulary, all of it!
　I'll even tame that mandrill!」

stage0500_01:r_d539a2fde4c693cd.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
（Ugh... this person really can't take a joke...）

stage0500_01:r_dda3b21648e98ee4.text:
$$シモン$$
「You're congratulating me?
　What's gotten into you?」

stage0500_01:r_9925dadf8a9a7f29.text:
$$ＡＧ$$

　I'm a little hurt.」

stage0500_01:r_50764c80f09f2bab.text:

stage0500_01:r_0188862f4afac150.text:
$$シモン$$
「If you insist, I'll do it!
　Kanji, math, vocabulary, all of it!
　I'll even tame that mandrill!」

stage0500_01:r_1ed119b36eb1f656.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
（Ugh... this person really can't take a joke...）

stage0500_01:r_1b5b53d59e57b44c.text:
$$キタン$$
「Heh... this much is nothing for me.」

stage0500_01:r_536db6f461fe783c.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Save that bravado for when you've won
　one person's heart,
　rather than shot down 80 enemies.」

stage0500_01:r_b69b5a3550b1f080.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'm not $$キタン$$ around.
　That's my candid opinion.」

stage0500_01:r_2be8f1332144ca9c.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh dear... that joke fell completely flat...」

stage0500_01:r_2b5203d22313121a.text:
$$ヨーコ$$
「Fair warning. Try using this celebration
　as an excuse to touch me,
　and I'll fill you with holes.」

stage0500_01:r_2b60299ce27b8552.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Touching your body would be worth
　even that sacrifice, $$ヨーコ$$!」

stage0500_01:r_906b736d679f985e.text:
$$ヨーコ$$
「How can you say something that pathetic
　with such conviction...?」

stage0500_01:r_0f28c66b60f42136.text:
$$ヨーコ$$
「Sorry, $$ＡＧ$$. I appreciate the thought,
　but that sacrifice isn't nearly enough
　for my flawless skin.」

stage0500_01:r_e0462f2403901fc6.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Working away from your family...
　You must be exhausted.」

stage0500_01:r_5541d113ca3d5044.text:
$$ダヤッカ$$
「It's to protect the people I love.
　I'm not tired at all.」

stage0500_01:r_f3fcc2fe422e4201.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Let's keep at it for sweet little $$アンネ$$, too.」

stage0500_01:r_481a3577cc6e6af7.text:
$$ダヤッカ$$
「Oh, $$ＡＧ$$!
　So you see how adorable $$アンネ$$ is too!」

stage0500_01:r_a83195eb05db0c69.text:
$$ダヤッカ$$
「Look at this picture. Look!
　Those lovely eyes... just like $$キヨウ$$'s. Yes.」

stage0500_01:r_34a18d0d0e0a8255.text:
$$ダヤッカ$$
「$$キヨウ$$ says the nose looks like mine,
　but I'd rather $$アンネ$$ looked like
　$$キヨウ$$ in every way...」

stage0500_01:r_a77aee82d7296405.text:
$$ダヤッカ$$
「Oh... but I am proud of my good health.
　I hope $$アンネ$$ takes after me there.」

stage0500_01:r_88c181eee37c2d7f.text:
$$ダヤッカ$$
「As for brains, $$キヨウ$$ and I are average,
　so hopefully $$アンネ$$ will take after
　$$キノン$$ or $$キヤル$$...」

stage0500_01:r_efc4f3b61868a78f.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
（Th-this doesn't look like
　it'll be over anytime soon...）

stage0500_01:r_68440bdd382a8d11.text:
$$ギミー$$
「Hehe... maybe I'm a bit closer to $$シモン$$ now.」

stage0500_01:r_4506a76af0aa0c6f.text:
$$ギミー$$
「W-what...?
　Are you saying I've still got a long way to go?」

stage0500_01:r_e90e8a6375c61e48.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That too, but $$シモン$$ is still improving,
　even as we speak.」

stage0500_01:r_63ff2433ff4fea3d.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「If you get complacent now, $$ギミー$$,
　$$シモン$$ will only leave you behind.」

stage0500_01:r_961e0349e6f98075.text:
$$ギミー$$
「You're right, $$ＡＧ$$.
　Thanks for the good advice.」

stage0500_01:r_e62baec1240534f8.text:
$$ギミー$$
「All right!
　I'll work even harder to catch up to $$シモン$$,
　and then surpass him!!」

stage0500_01:r_0767d3e04479534e.text:
$$ダリー$$
「Yes... I've become an ace pilot,
　but I wonder if I can ever become
　a wonderful woman like $$ヨーコ$$...」

stage0500_01:r_e9a6e85d1514df57.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Of course you can.
　As a $$ＤＥＭ$$-certified connoisseur
　of beautiful girls, I guarantee it.」

stage0500_01:r_ec931f9cccf4ce82.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You'll be a wonderful woman someday, $$ダリー$$...
　No, you're already wonderful right now.」

stage0500_01:r_129bf63e44494993.text:
$$ダリー$$
「Thank you, $$ＡＧ$$.
　But I think I still have a long way to go.」

stage0500_01:r_1acf21dae38ddca8.text:
$$ダリー$$
「So I'll keep trying.
　To become an even more wonderful woman.」

stage0500_01:r_d7e2f2fa9996ebb0.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
（The road to a figure like $$ヨーコ$$'s
　is long and steep, $$ダリー$$...）

stage0500_01:r_38b9d3eae509840f.text:
$$シンジ$$
「I never thought I could become an ace...」

stage0500_01:r_33afcd8fa9104484.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「What are you saying?
　I know very well how hard
　you've been trying, $$シンジ$$.」

stage0500_01:r_9df2c521bb27ef34.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You can stand on your own now, $$シンジ$$.」

stage0500_01:r_aa0568942e212ab8.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes.
　Every boy becomes a man someday.」

stage0500_01:r_006dae7136db6eb7.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Thank you, $$ＡＧ$$...
　I'll keep trying my best.」

stage0500_01:r_0447b7561e1b9c43.text:
$$シンジ$$
「I can't stay a child forever, after all.」

stage0500_01:r_bed6a08a4822ca06.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
（Whatever trials lie ahead,
　don't forget how you feel now, $$シンジ$$.）

stage0500_01:r_dbdd84457cec1c60.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Coming from you, that doesn't make me happy.
　It makes me suspicious.」

stage0500_01:r_c2ef53191234d1ed.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「How cruel.
　I'm congratulating you so sincerely, too.」

stage0500_01:r_52d2c1dbdcfed856.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Well, fine.
　It's better than nothing.」

stage0500_01:r_a1084d79b0419467.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Even that sharp tongue is cute...
　For now.」

stage0500_01:r_84aabe389c6f5b4f.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Someday you'll be able to accept
　other people's kindness openly, $$アスカ$$.
　Yes... when you grow up.」

stage0500_01:r_5e3ac0d504f95950.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'm sure you'll become
　a beautiful woman, $$アスカ$$.」

stage0500_01:r_fee4f632ab858e48.text:
$$アスカ$$
「W-what!?
　Where did that come from!?」

stage0500_01:r_a7b45ea31980b30f.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
（Hehe... still a child in that respect.）

stage0500_01:r_0239e6f001eeea79.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Naturally, I expected this response.
　So I'm not hurt in the slightest!」

stage0500_01:r_65e891c81bdf392f.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah... but I might just say
　that a little comment from you
　might possibly make me happy...」

stage0500_01:r_824cfaa8216a1a5a.text:
$$レイ#333$$
「I'm sorry.
　I don't know what to say
　at a time like this.」

stage0500_01:r_b0c65cbca2d84117.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Don't force yourself, $$レイ#333$$.
　Save those important words
　for a truly important moment.」

stage0500_01:r_d04d5f3363da24ab.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
（Just seeing that expression on your face
　is enough for me.）

stage0500_01:r_c85c68883bf4dcff.text:
$$マリ$$
「Oops... you've found me...
　I wasn't planning to show up somewhere like this.」

stage0500_01:r_c936f33340232027.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But while you're here,
　could you at least say a few words...?」

stage0500_01:r_1afca9648f371ecd.text:
$$マリ$$
「Sorry.
　For now, I'm still someone in the shadows.」

stage0500_01:r_f3956c9300397df0.text:
$$マリ$$
「Well... I'll keep doing things at my own pace.」

stage0500_01:r_f5be5abe937939e0.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
（Not that I'm one to talk,
　but just who is this person...?）

stage0500_01:r_d26ce554a3dc90cd.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「W-what's wrong, $n!?
　Thanking me? Do you have a fever!?」

stage0500_01:r_53e821e0c968b3ec.text:
$n
「Part of why I've managed to keep fighting
　this long is you and the $$ジェニオン$$.」

stage0500_01:r_3b268ed71957adf4.text:
$n
「Thanks, $$ＡＧ$$.
　I'll be counting on you from now on, too.」

stage0500_01:r_6739cae435415795.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「O-oh, stop it!
　Saying that won't get you anything!」

stage0500_01:r_6b3360baf39de6c1.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「B-besides, I-I'm only doing this
　to perfect the $$ジェニオン$$.
　It's not for your sake, $n!」

stage0500_01:r_f2de532808deaa81.text:
$n
「You're so flustered,
　you're completely out of character.」

stage0500_01:r_01513ffc53df4c26.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「One day I'll tune up the $$ジェニオン$$
　so much that even you can't handle it, $n!」

stage0500_01:r_7ca43ddc682ed3b7.text:
$n
「Go ahead and try.
　By then, I'll have improved even more.」

stage0500_01:r_d657a96509d4c875.text:
$n
「I'll become a pilot who won't lose to anyone...
　No, I'll make sure of it.」

stage0500_01:r_865bcf024754d295.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Very well.
　One day, I'll put those words to the test.」
